title: Value at the new left coordinate
statement: Let $r,k$ be nonnegative integers, $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^{r+2k}$, and $a,b\in\mathbb{F}_2$. The coordinate at index $r+2k$ of the image of the vector formed by appending $a,b$ to $x$ under the paired-coordinate automorphism for $k+1$ pairs is $a+\sum_i x_i$, with the sum taken in $\mathbb{F}_2$.
